subject: BlueCrest reserved GPU summary & action map
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@bluecrest.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: BlueCrest reserved GPU summary & action map

Hi Lena — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the immediate next steps so we have a shared action map.

Key pain points you flagged:
- Production latency variability during batched inference peaks (esp. overnight retraining window).
- Data isolation requirements — PHI scope for model inputs and strict audit logs.
- Cost unpredictability with current public endpoints when scaling to 10k+ concurrent requests.

Goals you want to hit in the next 3 months:
- Dedicated pool (reserved GPUs) for staging + prod with tenant-level isolation.
- 99th percentile generation latency under 450ms at baseline load.
- Formal SLA with uptime and incident response for prod.
- Procurement/PO path aligned for a March start.

Technical ask summary (from Ben):
- Isolation: VPC peering + customer-managed KMS for keys.
- Sizing: initial reserved pool of 8x A40-equivalent GPUs with burst capacity to 12 for peak jobs.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown and request tracing to integrate with your SRE dashboards.

Proposed next steps (owners & dates):
1) I will send a written SOW + capacity summary by EOD Thu 1/15 (Tessa) [attachment: bluecrest-capacity-summary-v1.pdf].
2) Ben to share a short ops-runbook snippet for VPC/KMS integration by Mon 1/19 (Ben).
3) Procurement to review PO template; Marissa to kick off procurement sync once we have internal pricing (Marissa).
4) Pilot kickoff: target week of 3/9 for reserved pool activation (mutual).

Open questions for BlueCrest:
- Confirm whether the PHI scope includes model output storage for 30 days or if stricter retention is required.
- Any mandatory vendor security questionnaire (we can fill the standard redwood pack).

If that aligns, I’ll circulate the SOW and a single-sheet pricing placeholder for procurement to react to.

Best,
Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0187 | tessa.morgan@redwood.inference
[attachment: bluecrest-capacity-summary-v1.pdf (PDF, 340KB)]

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@bluecrest.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@bluecrest.ai>, ops@bluecrest.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BlueCrest reserved GPU summary & action map

Tessa — this is very helpful, thanks. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- PHI retention: we must not retain model outputs longer than 7 days except in our secure archive (separate bucket). Please mark that as a requirement for the SOW.
- Desired SLA: 99.9% monthly uptime for the dedicated pool and a 2-hour P1 response window during business hours.
- Procurement: we need the PO template and an estimated MRR to share with finance — procurement@bluecrest.ai is looped and will send a vendor packet request if needed.

As for sizing, 8 reserved GPUs + burst to 12 sounds reasonable for initial loads. We may test higher concurrency in month two.

Next steps on our side:
- Procurement will send a vendor packet request by next Tue 1/20.
- Ops needs Ben’s runbook to validate network/policy changes.

Appreciate you moving quickly on the SOW.

Thanks,
Lena

--
Lena Ortiz
Head of ML Ops, BlueCrest Therapeutics
lena.ortiz@bluecrest.ai

Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BlueCrest reserved GPU summary & action map

Thanks Lena — noted on the 7-day retention and the 99.9% SLA / 2-hour P1 response window. I’ve attached the capacity summary and a PO placeholder for your finance team to review.

Attachment highlights:
- bluecrest-capacity-summary-v1.pdf: contains proposed pool sizing, burst policy, and preliminary pricing buckets.
- bluecrest-po-template.docx: simple PO layout with billing cadence options (monthly/quarterly/annual).

Marissa — can you use the pricing buckets in the attached PDF to draft a short commercial option set (monthly vs committed year)? We’ll need a one-page for procurement.

Ben — any notes to add to the runbook before you share with Lena’s ops team? If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute technical sync next Tue 1/20.

I’ll also push a HubSpot record update with the timeline and the attachments.

Best,
Tessa

Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 09:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BlueCrest reserved GPU summary & action map

Quick technical note for ops:
- Network: we recommend VPC peering with a dedicated subnet for the reserved pool. We’ll provide the CIDR ranges and security group examples in the runbook.
- KMS: customer-managed keys are supported; we’ll add HSM notes if BlueCrest requires FIPS/HSM.
- Burst policy: automatic burst to warm spare nodes rather than instant provisioning reduces cold-start latency — I suggest configuring a 10% warm buffer.

I’ll attach the ops-runbook snippet to the HubSpot record and upload to the Drive folder Tessa shared. Happy to join the 1/20 sync.

Ben
